790610201.text: Yes, it is. In the <color=#FFCC33FF>outside world</color>, there's no lack of new things to discover.

790610202.text: Right! There's lots to eat, and many fun things to do, and you'll even get to encounter many interesting things and awesome people. For example...

790610206.text: Really? Dear me. I'd believed the outside world to only be conscious of "value," and to be full of those who wish to wear hats but dare not.

790610207.text: Hmm, well, you can think of it... Like a cake with various chocolates scattered on top! Every bite's a whole new experience.

790610208.text: That's way better than having all the chocs taste the same — 'cause that would make for a super ordinary cake, right?

790610302.text: That's true. This is your home, after all, Esnoir. Paimon's sure you like it here. Also...

790610306.text: Indeed! I worry about losing these, and I fret about them constantly.

790610307.text: This is all good. Wonderful, even. I have no wish for them to change, nor do I wish to change.

790610308.text: But... Venturing abroad will cause everything to change. Won't it? Rozel?

790610309.text: Yes. It definitely will. I will not deceive you, nor do I wish to sadden you, dear Esnoir.

790610310.text: Alright... Alright. I understand where you're coming from, as I'm sure you do me.

790610311.text: I need time to consider your invitation before making my decision. If nothing else, let us simply enjoy this spot of tea in peace.

790610312.text: Alright. I will accompany you, Esnoir. There is still much time before my next voyage. Until then, let us consider this issue together.

790610401.text: Rozel, maybe... I can go with you. But... I just don't know where to even begin preparing.

790610402.text: That's easy. Prepare your jam, bread, and curiosity. Put on some comfortable clothes, and bring a spare set as well.

790610403.text: Finally, prepare yourself — Because you might have to throw some of those things out along the way.

790610404.text: Oh. It all sounds so complicated. And I don't want to throw them away, because they're mine, they're precious, and I like them.

790610405.text: And you'll discover new precious things after those leave you, my dear Esnoir.

790610406.text: Believe me, this will be a fascinating journey.

790610101.text: No matter how many times you ask, Rozel, I will not go out venturing with you.

790610102.text: You're my friend, yes, and that will never change. I do not dislike you. But... I do not enjoy traveling.

790610103.text: Esnoir. It is nowhere near as frightening as you imagine. It's just a trip, that's all.

790610104.text: The outside world plays host to many flowers that cannot be found in our village and many people we've never met — even the shapes of the clouds are different there.

790610105.text: Remember the seed I brought you from outside? I can guarantee that you've never seen any flower with its shape or color before.

790610106.text: It's still a seed now. I'll plant it, and then we'll see.

790610107.text: If you're willing to go with me, we might be able to see this flower with our own eyes.

790610108.text: Rozel... I'm sorry, I have no wish to travel abroad, nor do I want to become like those venturers.

790610109.text: They always fret about the value of carpets, and pay no mind to beautiful hats...

790610110.text: This is how your travels change you, and it scares me.

790610111.text: That is true. But have you noticed the maps, the plant samples, and the travelogues that fill their luggage to bursting?

790610112.text: We surge through different bushes and shrubs like a gust of wind, like rivers passing through another lake... We encounter different things, and we, too, become different people.

790610113.text: This is how travel changes you, and it scares me too... But I'm thankful for those changes as well.

790610114.text: I'd compare it to a slice of bread with cream slathered on both sides. You're going to make a mess no matter how carefully you try to hold it.

790610115.text: In that case, I'd spread the cream on separately. That way, I can even smear on different flavors.

790610118.text: Ah, it's you, here at last! Rozel has been telling me how wonderful the outside world is, inviting me along to venture...

790610119.text: Do you know much of that world? Is it... as he says it is?

790610501.text: I'm sorry, Rozel. I... still can't go with you.

790610502.text: It's enough for me to stay here. That way, there will be someone here waiting for you when you come back from venturing.

790610504.text: I'm not smart enough, nor brave enough, Rozel. But I believe...

790610505.text: I believe that the breeze rustles through the brush, the rivers run through the lakes, and the cycle begins anew. That in the end, all returns to where it began.

790610506.text: Perhaps, after experiencing so many changes, their final wish is still... to go back to being their old selves.

790610508.text: I will wait for you here, at home, my friend. As I ever have.

790610601.text: "This letter is for my neighbors, my friends, the lighthouse, and the little flower."

790610602.text: "I'm about to go out a-venturing with Rozel. Please feel free to use my swing, table, and stool."

790610701.text: ...I do hope that "change" will come a bit more slowly.
